scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names BACK,FRONT,CONSUMERS --prefix-colors cyan,green,magenta "bun run dev:backend" "bun run dev:frontend" "bun run dev:worker"
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd backend typecheck && bun run --cwd frontend typecheck
scripts.test: bun --env-file=../.env run --cwd backend test && bun run --cwd frontend test
scripts.browser:install: bun run --cwd backend playwright install chromium
scripts.test:e2e: bun --env-file=../.env run --cwd backend scripts/prepare-test-db.ts && bun --env-file=../.env run --cwd backend scripts/test-e2e.ts
